critique: The rotating, notched multicolour “lock” tiles coherently translate the egg-carton photograph’s dense repetition into a tactile unlocking wave, with blue carton cells puncturing the ochre field effectively. However, the regular orthogonal grid and centered square image remain highly conventional; a less predictable propagation rule or spatial rupture would better fulfill the anti-pattern brief, while the minuscule guinea pig at bottom left is functionally illegible.
